name: profiles-base
description: Provides common host preparation for all roles, including baseline packages, custom Facter directories, and shared directory structure.

name: profiles-consul
description: Installs and configures Consul agents and servers, including cluster joining, local checks, and Consul-template integration.

name: profiles-mysql
description: Provisions MySQL databases, users, grants, tunable server options, and master/slave replication behavior.

name: profiles-nagios
description: Installs and configures Nagios Core behind Nginx with plugins, NRPE checks, service templates, and Consul-template integration.

name: profiles-nginx
description: Configures Nginx reverse proxy services and deploys the compiled web-demo application with its systemd unit.

name: profiles-gitlab
description: Wraps the Puppet GitLab module to install and configure a GitLab server using Hiera-driven settings.

name: profiles-golang
description: Installs the Go toolchain required by the web-server role through the external Golang Puppet module.

name: profiles-puppetmaster
description: Configures the Puppet Server and PuppetDB control plane, including PostgreSQL-backed PuppetDB and CSR validation support.

name: profiles-release
description: Automates application releases from GitLab packages, including archive extraction, symlink switching, systemd services, Nginx proxying, and scheduled polling.

name: roles-base
description: Base composition role applied to all server roles and including the common host-preparation profile.

name: roles-application
description: Composes the application server role with release automation, Consul agent configuration, and NRPE monitoring.

name: roles-consul
description: Composes the Consul server role with base host preparation and Consul server configuration.

name: roles-database
description: Composes the MySQL database role with conditional replication configuration for non-master nodes.

name: roles-gitlab
description: Composes the GitLab server role with base host preparation and the GitLab profile.

name: roles-nagios
description: Composes the monitoring server role with Nagios, NRPE, Consul agent, and Consul-template configuration.

name: roles-puppetmaster
description: Composes the Puppet master and PuppetDB server role with base preparation and control-plane configuration.

name: roles-web-server
description: Composes the web server role with Go, Nginx reverse proxy, the demo application, and Consul agent configuration.
